name: Koalafication Perth 2019
information: This competition is part of a series of events around Australia to enable competitors to obtain qualifying results for the upcoming WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne. For more information, visit the [WCA World Championship 2019 website](https://wc2019.speedcubing.org.au/en/). **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
